items.title: PRISMA 2020
items.text: For systematic reviews: report the search strategy, the screening flow from records found to studies included, and the appraisal of study quality and risk of bias. The 27-item checklist (Page et al., BMJ 2021; CC BY 4.0) is not reproduced here; use the official checklist. Narrative and scoping reviews are not held to it.
